record.reason: LLaTTE studies multi-stage sequence modeling in production ad recommendation; the sequence module accounts for >90% of upstream inference FLOPs and ~30% online ranking FLOPs. It is a concrete serving-budget analysis but proprietary recommendation architecture, not general LLM serving.
record.title: LLaTTE: Scaling Laws for Multi-Stage Sequence Modeling in Large-Scale Ads Recommendation
